async.description: If true, execute cql query asynchronously. This may be faster if CPU is not overloaded.

batchSize.description: Batch size for get query which determines the number of ids in one query. -1 disables batching.

include.description:
List of column names or string containing comma-separated names of columns that need to be included or
namespaced column names in case the concept of grouping column by feature exists in the datastore;
for example: in HBase namespaced column name will be column_family:column_name.
If not set, all columns will be returned
Either one of {@link include} or {@link filter} or none should be provided for filtering. Providing both is
currently not supported

filter.description:
Needed to filter the columns based on specific condition instead of a static list of comma separated values.
Either one of {@link include} or {@link filter} or none should be provided for filtering. Providing both is currently not
supported

limit.description:
Total number of elements to scan. Use -1 for no limit.
The meaning of an element depends on the underlying database. For Cassandra see {@link Cassandra#scan}.

explain.description: Enable tracing info for this query from the underlying kv store (if supported) or return null

offset.description: Offset to use for paged reads.

kvColLimit.description: Internal limit for reading columns from kv rows
